OK so `resize` does set `flags = 0`. But in `constructXRef`, when it finds an object and sets `entries[num].offset`, `entries[num].gen`, `entries[num].type`, it does NOT set `entries[num].flags`. However, `resize` was called first which set `flags = 0`.

Wait, but `constructXRef` starts by doing `resize(0)` and then `gfree(entries)` and setting `entries = nullptr`. So the entries are freed and re-allocated via `resize` later. Let me look more carefully:
